text:
Maria (CS): Dry-run complete for Pinegrove private deploy. Quick summary of blockers we hit: IAM role missing sts:AssumeRole for audit-lambda, KMS alias not present, management subnet NACL blocking control plane, and audit logs not forwarding to Splunk. @Sam can you confirm firewall/NACL ETA? @Alex can you look at key policy?
Sam (Networking): Saw the NACL deny for 10.200.0.0/16 -> management. Ops needs explicit egress to 3.35.12.9:443 for our observability endpoint. Opening ticket now, ETA EOD PT.
Alex (Security): KMS alias issue: alias/rdw-pinegrove-logs wasn't created in the customer account. Also the key policy currently denies external services. Quick policy snippet that would unblock the forwarder (replace ACCOUNT_ID):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodForwarder",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-log-forwarder"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Alex (Security): I can push that change if Pinegrove is OK with adding the role ARN. Need confirmation from their security team.
Rachel (Eng PM): Can we re-run the dry-run on Tue 09:00 PT after fixes? Also flagging renewal risk: if cutover slips >2 weeks we escalate to AM for renewal mitigation.
Maria (CS): Audit pipeline: found missing Splunk forwarder config (no HEC token set). Example forwarder config we expect: 
```
outputs:
  splunk:
    host: splunk.prod.redwood
    hec_token: "REQUIRED"
    index: rdw-audit
```
Sam (Networking): Firewall change submitted: ticket INC-4821. Ops asked for explicit source list: Pinegrove management CIDR (10.200.0.0/16) + NAT egress 54.12.34.56. @Maria can you confirm final source IP list for ops?
Maria (CS): Sending list to ops and customer now: https://redwood.app/secure/pinegrove/egress-ips — pinging Pinegrove security for role ARN.
Alex (Security): IAM fix: audit-lambda's role needs this trust block to allow assume from our forwarder: "Service": "lambda.amazonaws.com" and the forwarder role ARN in the Principal. Small example: `{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-log-forwarder"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}`. I'll draft PR.
Rachel (Eng PM): I'll schedule the re-dry-run Tue 09:00 PT and book an enablement walkthrough for Pinegrove devs next Wed 10:00 PT. If the fixes land by EOD today we should be on track.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: canary-queue draining: 0/12 tasks active, no expected impact to the dry-run window.
Maria (CS): Action items recap: Sam -> confirm firewall/NACL by EOD, Alex -> update KMS alias & key policy + IAM trust, Rachel -> schedule re-dry-run and enablement, Maria -> confirm egress IP list with ops and customer. Any objections? :thumbsup:
Sam (Networking): :thumbsup:
Alex (Security): :thumbsup:
Rachel (Eng PM): Noted — adding a renewal-risk flag (medium) to the account tracker until cutover confirmed.
